# ReelsGrab
> Free online video and audio downloader for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and Facebook Videos.

ReelsGrab is a free web-based utility that enables users to download public videos and audio from Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube in high definition (1080p, 2K, 4K) and high-bitrate MP3 (up to 320kbps). No software installation or account registration is required.

## Key Features
- Instagram Reels Downloader: Download public Instagram Reels in original MP4 HD quality without watermark.
- Facebook Video Downloader: Save Facebook public and group videos in 720p, 1080p, and 4K resolutions.
- Facebook Reels Downloader: Download short-form Facebook Reels with original audio and music.
- YouTube to MP3 Converter: Extract high-fidelity audio up to 320kbps from YouTube videos and Shorts.
- YouTube to MP4 Downloader: Download YouTube videos in Full HD 1080p and 4K formats.
- Reels to MP3 Converter: Extract background audio and music tracks from Instagram and Facebook Reels.
- Bulk Reels Downloader: Batch-download multiple public Reels at once.
- Multilingual Support: Available in English, Spanish (Español), and Portuguese (Português).

## API Specification
- Endpoint: `/api/download`
- Method: POST
- Content-Type: `application/json`
- Request Payload: `{"url": "https://..."}`
- Response: JSON containing download streams, resolutions, bitrates, audio tracks, and direct download links.
